common_rules.owner: all nine new tools accept existing credential generation >=0; token required and compared before generation; null-token or retired owner OWNER_REQUIRED; no enrollment/rotation merely to use generation0
common_rules.unknown_fields: reject before mutation, even if framework would drop extra input; no name aliases or arbitrary paths
common_rules.target: contact mutation targets existing active stable ID only, missing/retired TARGET_UNAVAILABLE; no implicit registration; resolve/list display canonical name and retired_at without tokens or peer program/model
common_rules.generation_error: owner token authentication precedes expected generation comparison
common_rules.writes: receipt-bearing writes: single S1 fenced transaction, first successful UUID increments mutation_revision once including domain no-op, replay/read/reject zero. Exception touch_window_identity is quota-exempt bounded in-place activity update with no receipt/UUID; actual changed row increments revision once, no-op zero
common_rules.replay: fixed candidate receipt key(instance_id,agent_id,request_id) spans all tools and epochs; identical hash under currently matching binding/auth returns original commit result, not current domain state; different payload/epoch same UUID REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT after normal fence checks
common_rules.payload_hash: Normative canonical preimage and exact bytes defined in candidate_validation_contract.request_preimage; same string/hash used for client pending, server dedup and candidate historical verification. No reconstruction from results.
common_rules.replay_authorization: current owner/token/generation/fence first; replay does not bypass current credentials; old-token replay after recover refused. New credentials may inspect current state, but cannot relabel old UUID/generation as new success
common_rules.no_op: For receipt-bearing operations, new UUID always records one receipt/revision even if domain unchanged; same UUID replay changes no revision/time/expiry. No automatic UUID replacement after unknown outcome. Quota-exempt touch has no UUID/receipt and only increments revision for actual in-place activity changes.
common_rules.contact_request: existing approved or blocked unchanged for any expiry; approved expiry informational. Existing live pending unchanged. Expired pending only is renewed by new UUID, same link ID. New link pending. Self request SELF_CONTACT_NOT_SUPPORTED
common_rules.contact_response: target owner may preapprove or preblock absent link (active requester required). accept true writes approved and now+max(60,ttl); false writes blocked/expires null and ignores supplied TTL after type validation. Same accept with new UUID explicitly renews approved; false remains indefinite. Same UUID never renews
common_rules.macro: auto_accept=true fails CONTACT_TARGET_CONSENT_REQUIRED; any non-null welcome field fails CONTACT_MESSAGE_REQUIRES_S2B before write. Otherwise same request primitive. approval_required=(returned status!=approved), approval_required_from_agent_id=target ID if required else null. Blocked requires target owner to explicitly unblock, not requester retry
common_rules.list: SQL owner endpoint filter plus id>after_id ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT limit+1; join endpoint names/retired flags, never token. No SQL TEXT timestamp filtering. Returned contact effective/status evaluated at one observed_at
common_rules.refresh: same authenticated identity only, program/model/token/generation unchanged. task null preserves, empty clears, max2048. Optional window row/UUID must be both present and exact owner match; renew last_active and finite expiry in same transaction/receipt; no new mapping/rebind. Missing pair means no window mutation Owning-agent last_active also uses max(parsed previous,t) even without window; t is one operation timestamp. Exact saved receipt replay does not call touch again.
common_rules.window: Read-only verify exact owner/row/UUID in explicit shared DB snapshot; null expiry unbounded, finite expiry<=observed_at WINDOW_EXPIRED. Explicit refresh/register/dedicated touch may renew existing expired exact binding, never create/rebind. Touch available despite own quota and unresolved legitimate pending; credential/fence/current binding still mandatory. Existing S1-only behavior unchanged.
common_rules.storage: no new user output path; persistent dedup receipts in additive table of fixed candidate DB; transactional initialization/restart; candidate generation unchanged
common_rules.interruption: before commit rolls back state+receipt; after commit/before HTTP response replay returns stored outcome; no local output to complete before entry can recover
common_rules.request_uuid: canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID only; uppercase/braces/noncanonical REQUEST_ID_INVALID, not a second key; UUID syntax validated in handler too
common_rules.contact_expiry: approved expiry is informational for BOTH migrated and newly approved links, preserving released delivery behavior; pending expiry governs renewal only; blocked expiry is ignored and block remains until target owner accept=true
common_rules.contact_effective: link-only formula: status==approved, independent of expiry, policy and retired flags. Not permission-to-send. Endpoint retired flags supplied separately. At write/replay it is COMMIT-time value; list is READ-time; S2b always reauthorizes current rows in its transaction
common_rules.window_touch: Normative formula at operation timestamp t captured once after DB transaction/auth checks: window.last_active=max(parseUTC(old_window_last_active),t), owner.last_active=max(parseUTC(old_owner_last_active),t). For finite expiry new_expires=max(parseUTC(old_expires),t+configuredTTL); null stays null. Future saved activity never moves backward; clock rollback may be all-row no-op. Preserve old timestamp bytes for unchanged values, write changed values UTC ISO. For refresh/register same touch primitive runs within their existing receipt/revision logic. Dedicated touch uses no UUID/receipt/quota and increments mutation_revision/tracker ONCE iff any window/owner target value actually changes, else zero. No new row/rebind/task/program/model/token changes. Returns committed_at=t (observation timestamp of successful transaction, not a promise about clock at physical COMMIT), activity fields may exceed t.
common_rules.time: all persisted legacy naive timestamps parse as UTC; offset/Z parsed then compared as UTC datetime/epoch, never lexical TEXT/MAX comparison. Newly written values UTC ISO8601 with +00:00. Preserve old bytes unless legitimately updated. Invalid compared value TIMESTAMP_INVALID before domain/receipt mutation
common_rules.ttl: no 30day product cap; integer>=0 clamped to minimum60 like released. reject bool/nonint/negative or datetime overflow CONTACT_TTL_INVALID; accept=false does not compute expiry
common_rules.identity_schema: output_schema only is normative, explanatory response duplicate removed. Identity-shaped outputs include both id and agent_id as S1 does; credential_generation minimum0
common_rules.resolve: authenticated exact current canonical lookup_key resolution only, no ambiguous aliases or project-qualified interpretation, no listing or prefix search; returns target stable ID/name/retired flag. Retired is displayable here/list, contact mutations still refuse retired target. Unknown TARGET_UNAVAILABLE

candidate_validation_contract.init_transaction: Inside private unpublished staging ONLY: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, validate base proof/definitions, create fixed S2a DDL and pair index, user_version3, increment staged mutation_revision once to initialized_revision=last_validated_revision=1, COMMIT. Postvalidate in separate snapshot before final manifest/gate/publication. No external active authority is changed; startup only validates completed profile readonly. An interrupted staging operation is recovered by its owned preparation receipt, never a runtime upgrader.
candidate_validation_contract.post_write: quick_check/FK/FTS and exact allowed base+extension definitions; verify unique contact pairs, receipt owner/tool/version/three binding/hash/UTF8 JSON/output schema/digest/committed revision <=current revision, nondecreasing generation counters and retained baseline mapping. Row changes allowed only as supported runtime operations, not compared to original source rows. Unknown table/trigger/index/version/schema refused Canonical request preimage and response digest validated separately per request_preimage, even after local pending has been cleared. Require marker3/profile s2a-v1 and tracker=current mutation_revision. Historical receipts need not cover every revision: S1-compatible actions and heartbeat have different provenance, but all stage-aware writes atomically advance tracker. Runtime validator requires schema3/profile s2a-v1 only. Schema2 is refused; no diagnostic upgrade profile exists. Fixed management extension creation, domain changes, audit and receipt insertion all update tracker in the same transaction.
candidate_validation_contract.manifest: return profile/instance/candidate/epoch/current revision, schema digests and table count+canonical digest summary; not tokens/raw receipt content. Baseline checkpoint remains immutable; runtime manifest is distinct from migration preservation proof
candidate_validation_contract.retention: retain all successful full receipts for lifetime of isolated candidate; no expiry/delete/reuse. operation_receipt_limit now PER OWNER, default100000, positive explicit config increase under controlled restart. No candidate-wide receipt cap in this stage, so one owner cannot consume another quota. Per-owner admission and receipt count in one transaction, replay before quota check. Quota-exempt touch produces no receipt and remains available. Receipt storage grows with number of admitted owners; S2a does not claim a global disk quota; runtime operators monitor total bytes/count.
candidate_validation_contract.rollback: Any published initialized runtime has revision>=1 and cannot use the original pristine snapshot rollback gate. Never reset revision or delete extensions. Failed unpublished staging may only be resumed/rebuilt according to its owned preparation plan; it was never an authority. Published evidence is preserved; incident quarantine and another separately prepared candidate are the supported exits. No automatic import/export of used schema2 writes; PR7 or separate migration design required.

request_preimage.not_authenticity_proof: hash/digest are internal consistency checks, not signatures against a same-UID actor coherently rewriting DB; existing private file/inode/fence boundary remains

mixed_binary_contract.initialization: Explicit fresh preparation only, never startup DDL or existing root conversion. Schema2 reason CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_REQUIRES_REPREPARE; retain root and manually review uncarried S1 writes before choosing another source/candidate.

snapshot_contract.read: Every S2a read entry explicitly BEGIN DEFERRED before its first DB SELECT. Marker/profile/revision/tracker/owner/domain/receipt counts and observed revision all use this same connection+snapshot until output computed. Retain authority shared lock plus before/after file/authority checks. Never issue helper SELECT on another connection or in autocommit. S1-only and legacy unchanged
snapshot_contract.write: BEGIN IMMEDIATE before checking marker/profile/revision/tracker/auth; all domain writes/receipt/tracker update in that transaction. Reads do not modify revision. Health/management/list/verify/resolve/whois/fetch all covered, not only capacity inspect
snapshot_contract.interleavings: A read established before B normal commit returns coherent old state/revision, or A established after B returns coherent new state/revision; no false gap. Old noncooperative writer commit yields coherent old snapshot or mismatched new snapshot rejected, never fresh domain rows with old revision
snapshot_contract.operator_exception: incident operator inspect intentionally permits tracker gap but explicitly reports it in same read snapshot; does not label it validated runtime state

incident_operator_contract.choice: quarantine only in S2a, not tracker adoption; no invisible forward-fix path claimed
incident_operator_contract.inspect-runtime-incident: same-UID isolated operator CLI, typed config/binding and private pinned files. Acquire authority shared lock, explicit BEGIN DEFERRED. Permit ONLY tracker equality check bypass, still enforce instance/candidate/schema/integrity/owner/mode/sidecars. Return old tracked/current revision, marker/profile, per-table canonical digest/count and relevant receipt hashes, incident digest. No tokens/raw messages, no writes and no full runtime startup required. Schema3-specific, no schema2 conversion/cancel/abort entrance. Integrity/schema failure refuses normal inspection; unsafe file bodies are never followed or adopted.
incident_operator_contract.quarantine-runtime: explicit operator command with expected incident digest, expected old tracker/current revision range, operation UUID and --confirm-quarantine. Acquire same pinned authority LOCK_EX, re-snapshot exact digests/range, preflight all fixed roles before writing. Wrong digest/range/private schema rejects. Persist incident.json then authority quiescing at fresh epoch, then root_status=retired (phase remains quiescing), then quarantine.json complete receipt containing manifest/digests/old+new binding. Retain DB and all candidate files IN PLACE; no rename/delete/reset of DB/tracker/receipts, no network domain operation. A quarantined root never resumes in S2a. Only schema3 tracker-gap incident satisfying strict inspect preconditions is handled here. Malformed/unsafe input is refused and retained unchanged for external manual diagnosis; do not advertise this command as repairing or retiring arbitrary corrupt schema2 roots.
incident_operator_contract.interruption: fixed incident/quarantine phase records plus actual authority reconciled under EX on repeat same UUID. Before retirement authority stays quiescing; resume only completes retirement/receipt. If failure before authority change old candidate still fails tracker; no success claimed. Foreign file cannot be overwritten. Counters/revisions remain intact; authority epoch rotation intentionally fences old writers
incident_operator_contract.return_to_service: After quarantine, DIFFERENT isolated candidate and new client_name root only. Compare source/current candidate identity mappings and enrollment ID/generation/fingerprint inventory to retained quarantine manifest; claims/recovers performed only in quarantined candidate are NOT automatically present in new candidate. Do not copy stale credential JSON or assume token valid because numeric ID matches. Explicit operator enroll on NEW candidate: inspect current instance/candidate/agent ID/token-state/generation; claim if null-token, recover if token present, using its expected generation and fresh request UUID. Activate new local credential only against that current candidate CAS receipt and authenticated whois; verify inbox/read paths and new window binding. If token and generation actually match, any reuse still needs explicit current-binding authentication/receipt, never implicit fallback. Quarantined writes remain uncarried until reviewed; keep old evidence.
incident_operator_contract.reason: RUNTIME_WRITER_MISMATCH message points directly to these inspect/quarantine operator commands and states domain tools are stopped. Quarantine receipt never says repaired or adopted
incident_operator_contract.acceptance: gap still permits operator readonly inspect; wrong incident digest refuses unchanged; deliberate quarantine blocks all S1/S2a domain operations and retains DB/receipts; repeat after each output/authority step completes same receipt; another fresh isolated candidate can serve without modifying quarantined evidence

client_uuid_contract.fixed_slot: derived client_root/runtime/mutation-pending.json ONLY; magic orrery-global-operation-pending-v1; one pending mutation per client, no arbitrary path/history scan
client_uuid_contract.preflight: fixed layout/output_plan validates pending+mutex roles and file type/private mode/nlink before network. Normal receipt-bearing mutation requires pending current binding/identity and serial mutex. Dedicated liveness and explicit-resolution readers have separately stated stale-pending handling; never accept foreign role/magic as own. No unbounded root scan.. Existing #236 operator enrollment/finalize reader remains separate from normal all-role preflight; receipt/mutex roles are typed and fixed. No upgrade recreation role added.
client_uuid_contract.begin: before HTTP create UUID once, atomic private write planned payload under per-client nonblocking private file flock using fixed runtime/mutation.lock; this lock is also a fixed role, never touch external authority lock. Same pending exact intent resumes UUID, conflicting intent MUTATION_PENDING_CONFLICT before HTTP. Read-only observe and operator enrollment recovery remain usable Pending canonical_payload stores the identical request preimage defined in candidate_validation_contract.request_preimage; request_hash must recompute from these bytes. This applies only to receipt-bearing writes. Liveness has no pending gate or mutex acquisition; explicit resolution alone owns the stale pending cleanup.
client_uuid_contract.complete: authenticated schema/binding/request ID matched server result saved as phase=committed plus receipt atomically, then clear pending once result is durably available for reporting. Crash before clear replays same UUID; network uncertainty never replaces pending or generates new UUID Dedicated touch has no journal and is exempt from these UUID-completion steps.
client_uuid_contract.crash_points: planned journal before request, server commit/response lost, receipt save, pending unlink; restart invokes same exact tool/payload/UUID and no second server revision. Disk failure preserves prior valid pending for explicit retry; no completed flag without validated receipt
client_uuid_contract.credential_rotation: old token/generation pending cannot authenticate replay; current authenticated same identity may read current state and use explicit resolution under old digest. Old journal is not adopted; after deliberate resolution a NEW intended operation may use new UUID, without claiming old outcome was absent.
client_uuid_contract.operator_resolution: Explicit operator-only resolve-mutation --ack/--abandon with expected SHA256 of old pending. Acquire same fixed mutation.lock, validate old pending own magic/private/nlink/full schema/old binding, keep it separate from new context; reread exact digest under lock before unlink. Authenticate current context/credential/server binding in read-only calls, display old and new binding, UUID/tool/status and current state without token. Same stable ID required within same instance; epoch may differ. Across instance/candidate require explicit --accept-binding-change plus complete old/new binding arguments and current-owner authentication; never infer numeric ID continuity across instances. Action deletes/acknowledges ONLY local pending, no remote resend or rollback; local completion cannot prove old outcome. No rewriting old pending to new epoch, no new UUID automatically. Constructor has a narrowly scoped resolution reader so stale journal cannot block this entrance; foreign role/magic/owner is always refused. Normal mutations still blocked until explicit resolution Across instance/candidate, explicit old/new agent IDs are required too; operator acknowledges identity continuity is unproven and only disposes a local stale request. A different-ID pending is never accepted for network owner calls or receipt activation. Mutex has no server binding header, so clearing legitimate stale pending leaves the same mutex usable for new intended operation under valid current context. Across instance/agent changes operator reads old root via dedicated resolution reader and authenticates a separately supplied EXISTING current-context input from a new fixed client root; only old pending is disposed, old context/credential not rewritten, next normal operation uses new current root. The input is readonly, not arbitrary output path.
client_uuid_contract.binding_change: Normal entry fails closed on instance/candidate/epoch mismatch. S2a never changes an existing candidate epoch for initialization. Different candidate/instance requires independently verified current enrollment in a new fixed client_name root; do not copy old credential based on numeric ID or recreate old binding automatically. Current authenticated root may explicitly resolve old pending via the separately scoped reader. Same-candidate credential rotation uses existing #236 enroll/finalize recovery, not repin.
client_uuid_contract.lock_role: fixed runtime/mutation.lock: immutable JSON {kind:orrery-client-local-mutex-v1}; no instance/candidate/epoch/agent ID fields. Role belongs to fixed client root + OS UID, private regular nlink1, NOFOLLOW and pinned dev/inode within open operation. Create O_EXCL once with fsync before first network, validate exact magic/schema for every open, never unlink/rename/recreate while held. Does not authenticate server owner; context/credential/pending retain strict binding. Foreign old-bound header not auto-converted: explicit new client root required for obsolete unpublished layout.
client_uuid_contract.liveness_exception: touch_window_identity/verify/readonly observe do not acquire mutation.lock and never read pending as routing/authentication evidence. An own-magic pending for same instance+agent (possibly old candidate/epoch/generation) may remain structurally validated but unresolved; it does not block liveness using independently current context/credential/authority. No adoption/resend of old payload, no journal writes/deletes. A foreign role/magic/private-file error still refuses. If current context/credential themselves stale, no network exemption: explicit current-root reconciliation is required first. instance/agent change uses new current client root, never pretends numeric ID continuity.
